en-us:
Collaborate directly on a local network.

- Host a session on a selected private IPv4 network and share its invitation privately with trusted collaborators. Project changes and linked media transfer directly; no cloud service is used.
- One person edits at a time. Release and take the editing turn to hand work over; viewers receive updates but cannot edit or play.
- Save a separate project after leaving. Transferred media copies remain on each device and may be needed by saved projects.
- VST3 inserts and editing inside compound timelines are unavailable during a session. Keep linked sources unchanged while collaborating.
